sentences.en: We've been matched up with some strong teams this year.
sentences.zh: 今年我们被分到了一些强劲的对手。

sentences.en: If it rains, we will put off our practice match.
sentences.zh: 如果下雨，我们将推迟训练比赛。

sentences.en: The boxer had to lose weight for the title match.
sentences.zh: 为了争夺冠军头衔，拳手不得不减重。
